feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 November 2026 4:00pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 16 November 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales/ severe gales for a time.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure will continue to decline, as a deepening low in the Atlantic drives frontal systems into the area tonight.


##Wind##

East or southeast 5 or 6, increasing 7 or gale 8 later this evening, increasing occasionally severe gale 9 to the west of the Isle of Man overnight, gradually veering southwest 4 or 5 later tomorrow morning and occasionally 6 in the south.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate or rough later this evening, perhaps touching very rough in the west overnight, becoming mainly moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Rain quickly arriving this evening and becoming heavy at times. Rain becoming lighter and patchier later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in heavy rain until later,


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest mainly 4 or 5, becoming cyclonic 3 to 5 for a time overnight, before tending to settle east or southeast later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, perhaps heavy in places.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
